state_invariants: A workspace switch changes visible context only; it never closes the document.
A workspace switch never discards a preflight report or changes its bound document revision.
Document state, production state, and preflight state remain separate and inspectable.
The shell owns navigation and context selection; Core and PdfTool remain the semantic owners of PDF operations.
Compare remains an explicit OPEN product decision until issue #193 and the release exit gate approve absorption.
A missing action disposition blocks shell integration instead of inventing a default route.
